definition: A local operation that maps an absorbable support-growth component to a bounded family-chain target and then either refutes the component or removes it from the witness.
relation_to_family_chain_theorem: uses theorem only after target applicability is established
relation_to_payload_refinement: needs payload relation to connect source and target
relation_to_counterexample_status: needs preservation or refutation of counterexample status
caveat: Not the same as the lift map or theorem applicability.

definition: A normal support>8 witness with a recognized family-chain component matching an absorption trigger.
relation_to_family_chain_theorem: theorem applies only to the matched bounded target
relation_to_payload_refinement: payload must be restricted or refined through the matched component
caveat: Recognized source-form only; not arbitrary support-growth witness.

definition: The bounded target object constructed from the trigger component and lower-layer package.
relation_to_family_chain_theorem: before theorem use, object must be in fresh package
relation_to_payload_refinement: payload must agree with source target correspondence
caveat: Freshness proves availability, not semantic preservation.

definition: A predicate identifying a family-chain component that can be routed to a bounded theorem target.
relation_to_payload_refinement: payload effect depends on trigger contents
relation_to_counterexample_status: status effect depends on trigger contents
caveat: Trigger failure is not hidden; it is named.

definition: The lower-layer family-chain level selected by the trigger.
caveat: Layer selection does not prove arbitrary absorption.

definition: The payload carried from source component to target object.
relation_to_current_operation: needed for contradiction or smaller witness
relation_to_counterexample_status: status preservation depends on payload semantics
caveat: Payload preservation is not completed here.

definition: A branch where theorem applicability refutes the alleged obstruction instead of constructing a smaller witness.
relation_to_family_chain_theorem: direct use of bounded theorem after applicability
relation_to_payload_refinement: payload/status must identify the same obstruction
relation_to_counterexample_status: counterexample is refuted, not merely preserved
caveat: Contradiction branch is distinct from smaller-witness branch.

definition: A branch where the absorbable component is removed or replaced to form a strictly smaller witness candidate.
relation_to_family_chain_theorem: theorem may justify removal of component
relation_to_payload_refinement: payload must be preserved or refined
relation_to_counterexample_status: status must be preserved or reduced
caveat: Strict measure decrease is not proved for every absorption branch.

definition: Lift constructs target representation; absorption uses a target to close or reduce a source branch.
relation_to_family_chain_theorem: lift is an input, not the operation
caveat: Lift readiness is not absorption proof.

definition: Theorem applicability says a constructed target is in bounded scope; absorption decides what that implies for the source witness.
caveat: Applicability alone does not build a smaller witness.

definition: Lower-layer 7/7 freshness gives current theorem-data availability but not source-target semantic equality.
caveat: Fresh data is not a preservation theorem.

definition: Operation cannot apply because trigger, target, theorem applicability, measure decrease, payload transfer, or status transfer fails.
relation_to_current_operation: routes failure to named blocker or escape
caveat: Failure is not silently treated as success.

definition: Named residual branch after absorption does not close or reduce the witness under current scope.
caveat: Not closed without higher-support or status-congruence proof.

definition: The smaller-witness branch must strictly decrease support size or the selected lexicographic support tuple.
caveat: Contradiction branch need not be a smaller witness.

definition: The operation must preserve, reduce, or refute counterexample status; these are separate outcomes.
relation_to_family_chain_theorem: theorem refutes only matched bounded target
caveat: Do not conflate preservation, reduction, and refutation.

definition: Non-absorbable or preservation-failed residual cases remain named higher-support/status-congruence blockers.
caveat: No support9+ scan is started here.
